title: A Protocol for the Terminal Again
author: Mara Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Dravenmoor, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
